text:
sophia: quick check — i'm testing the embeddings endpoint for a mixed ingest pipeline. two quick questions: 1) how do we treat null vs empty-string inputs today? 2) truncation and batch limits: exact numbers?

kevin: short answers: nulls are treated as explicit missing values (we return null in the vector list). empty string -> returns a zero vector (all zeros). truncation = 65,536 characters per item by default. batch limit = 1024 items per request for hosted; Dedicated can be configured up to 8192.

matt: adding nuance — truncation is done on codepoints (unicode-aware), not bytes. we also try to preserve whole words when possible for the last chunk (we trim to the last whitespace within the safe window).

sophia: can you paste the request/response shape you expect? showing the mapping to vectors is helpful for the client SDKs.

kevin: sure — example request we use in tests:

```http
POST /v1/embeddings HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood-inference.dev
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer $KEY

{
  "model": "redwood-embed-large-v1",
  "inputs": ["hello world", "", null, "a very long document..."],
  "strict_mode": false
}
```

and expected response shape:

```json
{
  "model": "redwood-embed-large-v1",
  "data": [
    {"index": 0, "embedding": [0.001, -0.02, ...], "len": 1536},
    {"index": 1, "embedding": [0, 0, 0, ...], "len": 1536},
    {"index": 2, "embedding": null, "len": 0},
    {"index": 3, "embedding": [0.03, 0.001, ...], "len": 1536}
  ],
  "usage": {"input_characters": 18234, "truncated_items": 1}
}
```

kevin: notes: 1) we include index to map back to inputs; 2) len is vector dimensionality (1536 for this model); 3) for nulls we set embedding:null and len:0 to make downstream handling explicit.

anna: small doc/compat question — previously some SDKs coerced numbers and booleans to strings before sending. do we still accept those and coerce server-side?

matt: yes we still accept coercible scalar types server-side (int/float/bool -> string conversion) when strict_mode=false. strict_mode=true enforces input types (must be string or null).

kevin: CI notes: i added integration tests for: mixed inputs, empty string -> zero vector, null -> null embedding, and truncation hitting 65,536. tests ran in the dedicated pipeline.

ci-bot: integration-tests/#embeddings-mixed passed — build 2025.11.82 — 12:16 UTC :white_check_mark:

anna: can you open the docs PR to call out: per-item truncation char limit, unicode trimming behavior, batch limits per plan, and the strict_mode flag? reviewers: @kevin @matt

kevin: will do. i'll also add a small example showing how to map data[i] -> inputs[i] using the index field. pinging for a quick review when ready.

sophia: awesome, thanks. that covers the immediate integration questions. i'll update the ingest pipeline to treat nulls as missing and ignore zero vectors (we'll mark them as "empty_text").

kevin: FYI follow-up: opening PR 432 to docs + sdk-readme changes. i'll @announce in #eng when merged.

matt: tiny follow-up for ops — if a customer hits hosted batch limit (1024), the error code is 413 with body `{\"error\":\"batch_too_large\"}`, and for dedicated we return 429 if autoscaler limits block a large burst.

sophia: perfect, thanks everyone!
